purpose: Verify system opens dedicated course workspace when authorized user selects an associated course
preconditions: User is enrolled in or assigned to course C101
action_or_input: User requests to open course workspace for C101
expected_result: Course workspace for C101 opens successfully with status 200

purpose: Verify system displays syllabus, schedule, instructor(s), and TA(s) on course home page
preconditions: Course C101 workspace is configured with syllabus, schedule, instructors, and TAs
action_or_input: Authorized user views course home page for C101
expected_result: Course home displays syllabus, schedule, instructor contacts, and TA contacts

purpose: Verify course workspace access is granted to enrolled, assigned, or linked users
preconditions: User U1 has valid course association for course C101
action_or_input: User U1 requests access to C101 workspace
expected_result: Access is granted and course workspace data is returned

purpose: Verify system denies course workspace access to user not enrolled, assigned, or linked to the course
preconditions: User U2 has no enrollment, assignment, or linkage to course C101
action_or_input: User U2 requests access to C101 workspace
expected_result: Access is refused with HTTP 403 or 404 and no course details are disclosed

purpose: Verify Faculty can configure workspace for assigned course
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 updates workspace settings and details for C101
expected_result: Course workspace configuration is successfully saved and updated

purpose: Verify Faculty can publish and edit course details in assigned course workspace
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101 with existing course details
action_or_input: Faculty F1 edits syllabus text and publishes updated details
expected_result: Updated syllabus is stored and published to the course workspace

purpose: Verify Faculty can upload and add course materials as files, links, or notes
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 adds material item with valid note text, link URL, or file upload
expected_result: Material item of specified kind is successfully created and persisted

purpose: Verify Faculty can organize course materials into modules or weekly sections
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101 with existing material sections
action_or_input: Faculty F1 creates a module/weekly section and assigns material item to that section
expected_result: Material is associated with the section and appears organized under it

purpose: Verify Faculty can schedule future material release date/time
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 creates material and sets release timestamp to future date/time
expected_result: Material state is set to SCHEDULED with release_at timestamp stored

purpose: Verify system releases scheduled material when configured release time is reached
preconditions: Material M1 is in SCHEDULED state with release_at <= current server time
action_or_input: System scheduled release process executes
expected_result: Material M1 transitions from SCHEDULED to PUBLISHED state and becomes visible

purpose: Verify Student has read-only access to published course materials
preconditions: Student S1 is registered in C101; C101 has published and draft materials
action_or_input: Student S1 requests materials list for C101
expected_result: Published materials are returned in read-only form; draft/scheduled materials omitted

purpose: Verify TA has read-only access to published course materials
preconditions: TA T1 is assigned to C101; C101 has published materials
action_or_input: TA T1 requests materials list for C101
expected_result: Published materials are returned in read-only form

purpose: Verify Observer has read-only access to published course materials
preconditions: Observer O1 is linked to C101; C101 has published materials
action_or_input: Observer O1 requests materials list for C101
expected_result: Published materials are returned in read-only form with no write capabilities

purpose: Verify Faculty can post course-wide announcement
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 posts announcement with title and content
expected_result: Announcement is created, stored, and marked active for C101

purpose: Verify TA can post course-wide announcement when permitted by Faculty
preconditions: TA T1 is assigned to C101; course policy can_ta_post_announcements is enabled
action_or_input: TA T1 posts announcement for C101
expected_result: Announcement is created and posted successfully

purpose: Verify TA cannot post course-wide announcement when not permitted by Faculty
preconditions: TA T1 is assigned to C101; course policy can_ta_post_announcements is false
action_or_input: TA T1 attempts to post announcement for C101
expected_result: Request is refused with HTTP 403 Forbidden and announcement is not created

purpose: Verify system timestamps each posted course announcement
preconditions: Authorized user posts announcement in C101
action_or_input: User submits announcement payload
expected_result: Persisted announcement contains server-generated UTC created_at timestamp

purpose: Verify posted announcement is visible to all users enrolled in or linked to course
preconditions: Announcement A1 posted in C101; users S1 (Student), F1 (Faculty), T1 (TA), O1 (Observer) linked to C101
action_or_input: Each linked user requests announcements for C101
expected_result: Announcement A1 is visible in the announcement list for all linked users

purpose: Verify Faculty can create an assignment for assigned course
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 creates assignment for C101
expected_result: Assignment is created and associated with C101

purpose: Verify system captures due date, instructions, submission type, and points possible
preconditions: Faculty F1 creates assignment in C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 provides due_date, instructions, submission_type (FILE/TEXT/LINK), points_possible
expected_result: All configuration fields are stored accurately on the assignment record

purpose: Verify Faculty can edit an assignment
preconditions: Assignment A1 exists in C101; Faculty F1 assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 updates assignment instructions and due date
expected_result: Updated assignment fields are persisted successfully

purpose: Verify system maintains assignment in Draft state until publication
preconditions: Faculty F1 saves new assignment without publishing
action_or_input: Faculty F1 retrieves saved assignment
expected_result: Assignment has state DRAFT and is not visible to students

purpose: Verify Faculty can publish an assignment
preconditions: Assignment A1 is in DRAFT state with valid configuration; Faculty F1 assigned to course
action_or_input: Faculty F1 issues publish request for A1 with immediate release
expected_result: Assignment transitions to AVAILABLE state and becomes visible to students

purpose: Verify system withholds published assignment from Students until configured release date/time
preconditions: Assignment A1 published with future release timestamp; Student S1 enrolled
action_or_input: Student S1 requests visible assignments for C101 before release time
expected_result: Assignment A1 is omitted from student assignments list

purpose: Verify system releases scheduled assignment when release time is reached
preconditions: Assignment A1 in SCHEDULED state with release_at <= current server time
action_or_input: Scheduled content release task executes
expected_result: Assignment A1 transitions to AVAILABLE state and becomes visible to enrolled students

purpose: Verify Student can view and download released assignment
preconditions: Assignment A1 is in AVAILABLE state in course C101; Student S1 enrolled
action_or_input: Student S1 requests assignment details and downloads assignment content
expected_result: Assignment details and instructions content are returned to Student S1

purpose: Verify Student can submit assignment work conforming to configured submission type
preconditions: Assignment A1 is AVAILABLE with submission_type=TEXT; Student S1 enrolled
action_or_input: Student S1 submits text content before due date
expected_result: Submission is accepted, recorded, and HTTP 201 Created returned

purpose: Verify submission type mismatch is refused
preconditions: Assignment A1 configured with submission_type=FILE; Student S1 enrolled
action_or_input: Student S1 submits plain text payload without file
expected_result: Request refused with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity and no submission created

purpose: Verify system accepts and records Student submission made before due date
preconditions: Assignment A1 has due date in future; Student S1 enrolled with no prior submission
action_or_input: Student S1 submits valid work with timestamp <= due_date
expected_result: Submission is stored with submitted_at timestamp and status submitted

purpose: Verify submission attempted after due date is rejected
preconditions: Assignment A1 due date has passed (current time > due_date); Student S1 enrolled
action_or_input: Student S1 attempts to submit work
expected_result: Submission refused with HTTP 422 (SUBMISSION_DUE_DATE_EXCEEDED) and no row created

purpose: Verify Student can view own submission history
preconditions: Student S1 has submitted work for assignment A1
action_or_input: Student S1 requests submission history for A1
expected_result: Own submission record is returned with submitted timestamp and payload info

purpose: Verify system displays own submission status (submitted, missing)
preconditions: Student S1 submitted A1; Student S2 has not submitted A1
action_or_input: S1 and S2 request their submission status for A1
expected_result: S1 status is displayed as submitted; S2 status is displayed as missing

purpose: Verify Faculty can grade individual student submission by entering points and feedback
preconditions: Student submission SUB1 exists in C101; Faculty F1 assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 enters points and feedback for SUB1
expected_result: Grade record is created/saved in Draft state with points and feedback

purpose: Verify TA can grade individual student submission for assigned course
preconditions: Student submission SUB1 exists in C101; TA T1 assigned to C101
action_or_input: TA T1 enters points and feedback for SUB1
expected_result: Grade record is created/saved in Draft state attributed to TA T1

purpose: Verify system records identity of grader for each grading action
preconditions: TA T1 grades submission SUB1
action_or_input: TA T1 saves grade evaluation
expected_result: Grade record and grading attribution log explicitly record TA T1 user ID

purpose: Verify system holds grade and feedback in Draft state until Faculty release
preconditions: Grade G1 is saved by Faculty or TA for submission SUB1
action_or_input: Grader retrieves G1 before release
expected_result: Grade G1 state is DRAFT and has not been published to Student

purpose: Verify Student cannot view draft grade or feedback
preconditions: Submission SUB1 has draft grade G1
action_or_input: Student S1 (owner of SUB1) requests grade details
expected_result: Draft grade is omitted / returned as unreleased; student cannot see score/feedback

purpose: Verify Faculty can release draft grades and feedback to Students
preconditions: Grade G1 is in DRAFT state; Faculty F1 assigned to course
action_or_input: Faculty F1 executes release grade action
expected_result: Grade G1 state transitions from DRAFT to RELEASED and releasing actor/time recorded

purpose: Verify Student can view own released grade and feedback
preconditions: Grade G1 is in RELEASED state for submission by Student S1
action_or_input: Student S1 requests own grade for the assignment
expected_result: Released score and feedback are displayed to Student S1

purpose: Verify released grade and feedback are read-only to Student
preconditions: Grade G1 is RELEASED for Student S1
action_or_input: Student S1 attempts to modify or update grade G1
expected_result: Request refused with HTTP 403 Forbidden and grade remains unchanged

purpose: Verify system logs actor who made post-release grade change
preconditions: Grade G1 is in RELEASED state; Faculty F1 assigned to course
action_or_input: Faculty F1 updates points/feedback on released grade G1
expected_result: GradeAuditLog record is created recording Faculty F1 user ID as changed_by

purpose: Verify system logs timestamp when post-release grade change occurs
preconditions: Grade G1 is in RELEASED state; Faculty F1 modifies G1
action_or_input: Faculty F1 saves updated score
expected_result: GradeAuditLog record contains authoritative UTC timestamp of the change

purpose: Verify TA can view course details, published materials, and announcements
preconditions: TA T1 assigned to course C101
action_or_input: TA T1 requests course details, materials, and announcements
expected_result: Content is returned successfully in read-only form

purpose: Verify TA can view Student submissions for assigned course
preconditions: TA T1 assigned to C101; submissions exist in C101
action_or_input: TA T1 requests submissions list for an assignment in C101
expected_result: Student submissions are returned to TA T1 for grading review

purpose: Verify system prevents TA from creating or editing assignments
preconditions: TA T1 assigned to course C101
action_or_input: TA T1 attempts to create or edit an assignment in C101
expected_result: Request is refused with HTTP 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify system prevents TA from creating or editing course materials
preconditions: TA T1 assigned to course C101
action_or_input: TA T1 attempts to add or edit course material in C101
expected_result: Request is refused with HTTP 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify system prevents TA from modifying course structure or sections
preconditions: TA T1 assigned to course C101
action_or_input: TA T1 attempts to create or modify material sections in C101
expected_result: Request is refused with HTTP 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify Observer can view course details, published materials, and announcements for linked course
preconditions: Observer O1 linked to course C101
action_or_input: Observer O1 views course details, published materials, and announcements
expected_result: Content is returned in read-only view

purpose: Verify system prevents Observer from viewing individual student submissions
preconditions: Observer O1 linked to course C101; submissions exist in C101
action_or_input: Observer O1 attempts to view student submissions
expected_result: Request is refused with HTTP 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify system prevents Observer from viewing student grades or student-specific data
preconditions: Observer O1 linked to course C101; student grades exist in C101
action_or_input: Observer O1 attempts to view student grades or roster
expected_result: Request is refused with HTTP 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify system prevents Observer from performing any write access anywhere in module
preconditions: Observer O1 linked to course C101
action_or_input: Observer O1 attempts POST/PATCH/DELETE on courses, materials, announcements, assignments, submissions, or grades
expected_result: All write requests are refused with HTTP 403 Forbidden
